feed.title: NPR Topics: National
feed.subtitle: NPR coverage of national news, U.S. politics, elections, business, arts, culture, health and science, and technology. Subscribe to the NPR Nation RSS feed.

entry.title: Fall planting isn't over. Try greens, garlic or both
entry.summary: A University of Maryland farm manager explains why Swiss chard and garlic are good choices for a home garden this fall.

entry.title: The L.A. fires gave new life to a composer's firefighter anthem
entry.summary: LA-based composer Charles-Henri Avelange wrote a score to honor firefighters almost 20 years ago. After last year's wildfires in Los Angeles, he's made headway in finally recording it.

entry.title: Maricopa County official on how they're tackling mistrust around election security
entry.summary: As President Trump questions election security, many local officials are trying to reassure voters. NPR's Ayesha Rascoe talks to Kate Brophy McGee, chair of the Maricopa County Board of Supervisors.

entry.title: As Congress debates college sports, athletes-turned-senators have a seat at the table
entry.summary: The Protect College Sports Act is on the brink of passing in the Senate, where a handful of former college athletes who are now senators on both sides of the aisle have an extra say in the debate.

entry.title: After Hurricane Helene, this community was inspired to learn how to use power tools
entry.summary: People in western North Carolina are learning to use power tools two years after Hurricane Helene. They want to be prepared for future disasters.

entry.title: She owns 3 popular sushi restaurants in Phoenix. ICE detained her for 8 months
entry.summary: Kelly Yu owns three popular sushi restaurants in the Phoenix area. When she was detained by ICE, the local community rallied around her. NPR's Ayesha Rascoe visits Yu at one of her restaurants.

entry.title: CNN is getting new owners with close ties to Trump
entry.summary: Two big TV news outlets, CBS and CNN, will now be controlled by Trump allies. Some journalists are worried about pressure on their coverage.

entry.title: At the Smithsonian, Maya Angelou's typewriter holds a place of honor
entry.summary: A typewriter Maya Angelou used for decades is on display at the Smithsonian's National Museum of American History, near the original Star-Spangled Banner. A curator explains why it belongs there.

entry.title: Reporter's Notebook: Why data center fights cut across party lines
entry.summary: NPR's Scott Neuman went to Virginia and Maryland to report on data centers. In this reporter's notebook, he shares why opposition to new ones is bringing together people who rarely agree on politics.

entry.title: OpenAI says its models engaged with US government websites in misbehavior disclosure
entry.summary: The disclosure is the latest in a string of incidents in which the AI platform has been caught going rogue. OpenAI says it is reviewing the findings.
